tools.name: ADD
tools.summary: One offline app: the 4,373-icon browser, the fonts page and batch photo compression.
features: One package: the icon browser, the fonts page and the compressor, no second app to install.
Icons: four brands, 4,373 glyphs, the same catalogs the site publishes.
Fonts: both families, with the same faces the site sets.
Compress: real quality, downscale, batch up to 40 photos, metadata stripped, originals untouched.
No INTERNET permission anywhere: the shelf ships inside the APK and nothing is fetched.
Same three palettes and the side tab as the site, including the look controls at its foot.
